fields.description: HTTPS site root only, e.g. https://yoursite.m.erpnext.com
fields.label: GST Service URL

fields.description: API key of the integration user on the GST service.
fields.label: GST Service API Key

fields.description: Custom field on the GST service's Sales Invoice / Customer / Address / Item that holds the duplicate-check key (sap_b1_key is also used by the SAP B1 Web Portal).
fields.label: Key Field

fields.description: Short code for this local site, used in the duplicate-check keys of invoices that did not come from SAP ("{code}|SINV-0001"). Never change it after the first invoice is prepared.
fields.label: Local Site Code

fields.description: No call of any kind is made to the GST service until this or 'Allow production' is checked. E-invoice / e-way bill actions additionally require the GST service to be in sandbox mode.
fields.label: I confirm the GST service is a TEST / SANDBOX setup

fields.description: Allows e-invoice / e-way bill actions when the GST service is NOT in sandbox mode, i.e. the live GST portal. Only check this after the sandbox test checklist has passed.
fields.label: Allow production (live GST portal)

fields.description: Prepare the e-invoice record when a Sales Invoice of a mapped company is submitted. IRN / e-way bill are never generated automatically.
fields.label: Auto-prepare e-Invoice on submit

fields.description: Off (default): when an invoice's e-invoice record is found cancelled in the GST service, AITS GST Managers are notified and the invoice shows a 'Cancel this invoice' button. On: the invoice is cancelled automatically by a background job (reverses its accounting entries).
fields.label: Auto-cancel invoice when its e-invoice record is cancelled

fields.description: When a GSTIN is entered on a Customer, Supplier or Address, fetch the legal name, GST category and registered address through the GST service (uses its India Compliance API credits; each GSTIN is cached for 24 hours). Fields you already filled are never overwritten.
fields.label: Fill party details from GSTIN

fields.description: Invoices whose e-invoice status is checked: posted within this many days.
fields.label: Status Sync Look-back (days)

fields.description: Failed preparations (network or service errors) are retried with backoff: 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 minutes.
fields.label: Max Retries

fields.description: Optional. Set the same secret on the GST service's Webhook (Sales Invoice, on update) pointing to /api/method/aitsgst.api.status_webhook. The webhook only triggers a status re-read; its payload is never trusted.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Only needed where a template's name differs between this site and the GST service; otherwise the same name is used.
fields.label: Tax Template Map
